items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: Lionel and I had a contract with Sebastian, too.

ctx.x: had, so he said, "We're going to have it Easter Sunday." And I said, "Well, I don't think I can make it." Well, "That's all right, then. We'll get somebody from the studio." Well, what'd he say that for?

I told him, I said, "Now, you do just that." And I had a contract. Lionel and I had a contract with Sebastian, too. And that was on a Sunday. And so I didn't make the rehearsal. I don't know who they got. To take pictures, that's all he wanted, to take pictures for the next day's paper. So I came on to work, and after that work I went to Sebastian and told him I was through.

Well, "No, we got contracts," and so and so. So Les Hite Height, who at that time was leader of the band, and we got together and talked, and he said, "Oh, well, if he wants to go, let's let him go. We'll let him see the East," and like that. So I quit on a Tuesday, was my last day. After that Tuesday this Irving Mills came in the place, and there again we were doing, as I was doing, a lot of soloing. I had a solo in the show, the floor show. I was playing "Trees." You know, the old religious piece, "Trees." And…
